statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has intermittent palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia
The service is cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271)
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and G45.9
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
The service is not separately payable under current policy guidelines
